notes: Fixed a real bug where the voice assistant and command center only checked for a Claude key before attempting any cloud AI call, so an OpenAI-only setup silently fell back to a vague local analysis instead of calling OpenAI. The local fallback analysis was removed entirely per explicit request; a failed cloud connection now returns a clear, honest error instead. Also adds the first real correctness test suite for engine calculations (fuel intelligence, data logic validator) beyond structural/integrity checks.
